findings.reason: MI001 remains NOT_FOUND, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at adequacy, originating in main:/missing_information/items/0. Its proposal-reported limitation is that no Mouse-sheet source gives per-regimen CFU tables; attachment bodies were NOT_SEARCHED in that assessment. This reviewed item supplies modeled exposure percentages without CFU responses, baselines, response windows, experimental-unit uncertainty or regimen-to-response links. It therefore cannot establish DRQ29 or support the matched-record comparison required by SC034–SC035 and R12. This page does not establish absence throughout the workbook. Independent PK and exposure-summary tasks remain separately assessable.
findings.needed_material: At adequacy review before QC, explicitly assess MI001 using permitted source coverage and record its outcome. Locate per-regimen measured responses, organism/strain and infection site, baseline or comparator, response window, dose histories, matched strain MICs, free-exposure links and experimental-unit uncertainty; keep index ranking and new target estimation pending if these remain unavailable.

findings.reason: The table provides source-backed modeled fT>MIC percentages by MIC in µg/ml, but does not define the free-concentration basis, underlying profile, percentage denominator, window boundaries or time origin. Retain the current percentages as reported summaries pending downstream review.
